title: Back to Daylight
subtitle: A 90-Day Sobriety Journal with Daily Prompts, Craving and HALT Check-ins, Milestones and a Relapse-Prevention Plan for Alcohol and Addiction Recovery
description_html:
Ninety days. One honest page at a time.

Back to Daylight is a guided sobriety journal for your first ninety days without drinking or using. Mornings take two minutes. Evenings ask a new question every day, so the journal grows with you instead of repeating itself.

Inside:

  • 90 different prompts in 13 weekly themes, from getting through the first days to planning the next ninety
  • A daily check-in: mood, cravings, strength of the strongest craving, the HALT check (Hungry, Angry, Lonely, Tired), what set it off and what you did instead
  • Your trigger map, a step-by-step craving plan and a relapse-prevention plan you fill in
  • Milestone pages at 24 hours, one week, two weeks, 30, 60 and 90 days
  • 13 weekly reviews with a mood, craving and sleep table
  • Money and time saved tracker, support contacts, meeting log and a 90-day tick grid

Works for alcohol or any other substance, whether you are on Day 1 or a few weeks in. 6 x 9 inches, 130 pages, matte cover. A thoughtful gift for someone starting recovery.

A support tool, not a replacement for medical or professional help.
research: 24 Nov 2026: 584 results for 'sobriety journal'; top sellers BSR 96k-233k with 3-42 reviews. 1-3 star complaints: same prompt every day, grammar errors, written only for active drinkers, too much blank space, 'nothing but a cute cover'. Title 'Clear Days' already taken -> 'Back to Daylight' (no matches).
